I made this von Mises if you want to use it. I just ripped it from the circular R package and simplified it (does not account for kappa == 0 or kappa > 1e+05). I'm sure there could be improvements.

## Basic implementation that assumes radians.
## Adapted from circular:::DvonmisesRad
dvm_rad <- function (x, mu, kappa, log = FALSE)
{
  logI0 <- -kappa + log(besselI(x = kappa, nu = 0.0)) ## Default expon.scaled = FALSE so adding the scaling (exp(-kappa)) manually.
  log_vm <- -(log(2 * pi) + logI0 + kappa) + kappa * (cos(x - mu))
  if(log) return(log_vm)
  else return(exp(log_vm))
}
x <- -1
F <- MakeTape(function(par){ dvm_rad(x = x, mu = par[1], kappa = par[2]) }, c(0.5,0.1))
circular:::DvonmisesRad(x, 0.5, 0.1)
F(c(0.5, 0.1))
F$jacobian(c(0.5,0.1))

Cheers
